panels.title: Zone status (inferred demand)
panels.description:
There is no Modbus register for the room-thermostat input (X42M), so demand is inferred:
• demand served = zone running (DI20/DI21) and zone pump on
• frost protection = zone running while DI14/DI15 is set (runs without thermostat demand)
• running, pump off = zone active but pump stopped (transition, restart delay, defrost)
• off = zone not running: no demand, or demand not served (zone switched off, error, wrong control mode/wiring)
A zone that shows 'demand served' continuously, even when the thermostat is satisfied, is most likely set to leaving-water control ([1.12]/[2.12] = Départ d'eau) or still in the screed-drying program.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensordata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "altherma4" and (r._field == "d_main_zone" or r._field == "mix_pump_pwm" or r._field == "d_frost_protection" or r._field == "d_pipe_freeze"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.d_main_zone)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "Main zone (floor)", _value:
       if r.d_main_zone < 0.5 then 0.0
       else if (exists r.d_frost_protection and r.d_frost_protection > 0.5) or (exists r.d_pipe_freeze and r.d_pipe_freeze > 0.5) then 2.0
       else if exists r.mix_pump_pwm and r.mix_pump_pwm < 95.0 then 3.0
       else 1.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "sensordata")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "altherma4" and (r._field == "d_add_zone" or r._field == "direct_pump_pwm" or r._field == "d_frost_protection" or r._field == "d_pipe_freeze"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.d_add_zone)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: "Radiator zone", _value:
       if r.d_add_zone < 0.5 then 0.0
       else if (exists r.d_frost_protection and r.d_frost_protection > 0.5) or (exists r.d_pipe_freeze and r.d_pipe_freeze > 0.5) then 2.0
       else if exists r.direct_pump_pwm and r.direct_pump_pwm < 95.0 then 3.0
       else 1.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
